caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a handle, centrally placed against a plain, cream-colored background. The pitcher is predominantly light brown, textured to resemble wood grain, with two horizontal beige bands encircling its body. Ornamental elements include green leaves and a bird sculpted in relief on the body of the pitcher. The handle is straight with rounded corners and features a row of small circular designs along its edge. There are no objects other than the pitcher in the drawing, and the name "Carl Buergerniss." is written in small, blue letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
